name: Ultimate Light Rail
summary: Light rail stations, a pedestrian underpass and native tramtrack with low exterior fences.
description: Ultimate Light Rail 0.10.3 (formerly Ultimate Metro) adds tram-based light rail stations: a surface terminus, an underground terminus and a through station with a pedestrian underpass. Stations use two 80m platforms and ordinary electric tramtrack connections. The through station offers street access at the front, middle and rear of both platforms. The surface terminus includes a compact scissors crossover and a landscaped head plaza. The underground terminus uses native underground station assets and street-level pedestrian access. Station type, length and platform count are not configurable yet. A separate Light Rail track option adds low native exterior metal fences to ordinary tramtrack, preserving native traffic, speeds and costs. Surface station approaches have the same fences up to the platform ends, leaving all platform accesses open. Existing tracks are not changed. The internal mod ID and all station resources are preserved for existing saves; no station rebuilding is required. Do not remove the mod while its stations remain.
